criteria.name: Identity and source-backed footprint
evidence: Raw ArcGIS feature is FID 296, code UPOF, name Utility Plant Office Facility.
Fresh Blender readback finds ten footprint vertices and maximum local-coordinate error 0.000000551 m against the source ring.
The z20 orthophoto overlay shows the magenta feature outline closely following the roof, including the east-side projection.
criteria.assessment: Full credit. Stable identity and the non-rectangular footprint are verified numerically and visually.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale
evidence: Local footprint is 20.862 × 23.945 m; computed source area is 446.009 m² and model area is 446.006 m².
Longest-axis rotation is 0.441° from north.
Explicit campus placement_origin_xy_m is [105.20840981346892, -1052.103607498187].
criteria.assessment: Full credit. Footprint and site anchor agree with supplied ArcGIS projection method to high precision.

criteria.name: Height, floors, and roof evidence
evidence: ArcGIS attributes report NUM_LEVELS=2 and CountOfFLO=2.
Model shell height is 6.88 m and highest mesh is 7.32 m.
ArcGIS Extrution=24 has undocumented units; source provenance explicitly treats 7.3 m as an estimate, not verified survey height.
62 E-W oriented seam objects match the z20 orthophoto, whose roof appears bright and near-continuous. No large equipment/hatch objects remain.
criteria.assessment: Strong two-floor low-profile roof treatment, but exact eave/parapet height and seam spacing remain estimates. Absence of HVAC/hatch is justified by the newer imagery, which does not substantiate them.

criteria.name: Facade, east entry, and distinctive details
evidence: Official OEP page identifies the main entry on the east wall; asset includes a distinct entry projection and paired dark doors on that side.
OEP describes an administrative building, mostly cubicle workspace, with Utility Engineering/BAS staff upstairs; model has schematic interiors on both floors (30 objects each).
Oblique render shows light gray vertically ribbed walls, repetitive dark window/panel forms, floor divider, plinth, and east entry.
ECN camera is captioned “from UPOF” but the captured close wall is not conclusively identified as UPOF; source provenance correctly limits this to contextual support.
criteria.assessment: Entry placement and restrained industrial material treatment are plausible and evidence-aware. Direct facade imagery is lacking: repeated window positions, glazing, wall panel system, and elevation composition are estimated; rendered window faces read nearly opaque and unusually dark. Interior is explicitly schematic/unverified.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and evidence
evidence: Fresh Blender 5.2.3 process opened the asset and found expected scene and export collection.
Export collection has 361 objects (359 meshes); external image files and missing unpacked images are both absent. All 13 materials are procedural.
Separate evidence includes build/validation records, provenance, orthophoto overlay, raw imagery tiles, OEP snapshot, webcam page/image, and fresh-open render/probe.
criteria.assessment: Portable self-contained asset with substantial evidence. Procedural, mostly monochrome surfaces are reliable and dependency-free but could use richer facade/window variation.

evidence: fresh_open_probe.json: current Blender 5.2.3 readback, geometry comparisons, dimensions, object/material/dependency counts.
fresh_open_oblique.png: fresh render from opened asset; visual assessment of roof, facade, windows, entry and massing.
../previews/utility_plant_office_facility_gis_orthophoto_overlay.png: z20 Esri roof/footprint comparison.
../sources/arcgis_fid296_feature.json and ../source_provenance.json: raw GIS feature, projection method and stated uncertainty.
../sources/purdue_oep_upof.html: official OEP program and east-entry source.
../sources/purdue_ecn_webcam_from_upof_2026_05_18_11_00.jpg: contextual facade clue; not treated as confirmed elevation.

findings.finding: The roof equipment and hatch removal is a well-supported correction: the z20 outline overlays a largely uninterrupted roof and does not identify those objects.
E-W roof rib direction now agrees with the north-up orthophoto.
Facade treatment remains uncertain because no direct UPOF elevation is provided by the available OEP, ECN, or overhead imagery.

For a higher facade score, seek a clearly geolocated/direct UPOF street or ground-level facade image; then replace the estimated repeated dark panels with evidenced window sizes, spacing, glazing reflectance, and cladding breaks. Keep these marked estimated until direct imagery is found.
The ArcGIS Extrution field unit is undocumented. Do not describe the 6.88 m shell / 7.32 m total as verified height; preserve as an estimate unless a reliable elevation source is found.
Interior rooms are schematic because the OEP page gives limited program facts rather than a measured architectural plan.

method: Independent criterion-based review of source snapshots, fresh-process Blender readback, numeric footprint comparison, and renders. No prior grader score was used to determine rubric points.
